description: High-performance Skia-rendered CollectionView for .NET MAUI (Android). Bakes DataTemplate rows into GPU textures with virtualization, lazy image loading, tap/long-press hit detection, in-cell text editing (Entry/Editor with per-keystroke cell repaint) and a Roslyn source generator that compiles XAML DataTemplates into Skia render trees. Includes Skia counterparts for Border, Grid, Label, Image, StackLayouts, Button, ImageButton (with per-side BorderWidth), Entry, Editor, CheckBox, BoxView, ContentView and ScrollView.
releaseNotes:
2.0.0-rc.2.9: SnapToPoints (default false): a list comes to rest with an item at its start, sliding (220 ms) to the nearest item after a drag or a fling; grids snap by rows. Templates: a ContentView can show a keyed ControlTemplate from the same file or another one (App.xaml, a ResourceDictionary), or an inline one; the generator bakes each into its own factory, and its bindings use the ContentView's BindingContext (ContentPresenter and TemplateBinding aren't supported). A list in unlimited space (a ScrollView, or a StackLayout along its scroll axis) with no length set is as long as its items; Minimum/Maximum*Request on that axis bound the length. SkiaEx.BoldFormatArguments and SkiaEx.ArgumentsColor on a Label or Button draw the values its StringFormat substitutes bold and in their own color.

2.0.0-rc.2.8: ImageButton respects Opacity, including its loading indicator. LoaderShown forces the image loader and hides image content; false restores automatic loading/ready/error behavior. Available directly on SkiaImage/SkiaImageButton or through SkiaEx.LoaderShown on MAUI images. The bundled generator supports nested Content on custom renderable controls; ISkiaContentHost includes their images in row loading and caching.

2.0.0-rc.2.7: fixes a crash with a SkiaCollectionView inside MAUI's CollectionView ("other motion event must not be null" in MauiRecyclerView.dispatchTouchEvent): the list no longer disposes the .NET wrappers of touch events, which other views handling the same event could still be using.

2.0.0-rc.2.6: Android: frames are drawn by Android's renderer (UseAndroidNativeDraw, default true; needs UseSkiaCollectionView() in MauiProgram). Card textures live in immutable Android bitmaps uploaded to the GPU once, and a frame is a few draw commands per card, instead of a full-list bitmap blended on the UI thread and uploaded every frame (UI-thread time per frame 1.1-1.6 ms instead of 8.8 ms on a Galaxy Tab A9). Images: a picture already on disk no longer waits behind slow downloads (a card scrolled back into view could show its spinner for minutes); cards with the same link share one download; SkiaImageLoader.RequestTimeout (5 s per attempt). Coming back to the app no longer rebuilds every row: size changes are applied once they settle (250 ms).

2.0.0-rc.2.5: the loading spinner is Android's own animated progress drawable, placed in the overlay of the list's native view. It turns on Android's render thread, so the list is no longer repainted while pictures load (it was about 30 times a second).

2.0.0-rc.2.4: network pictures in rows show a spinner while they download and a crossed-out picture when the source gives no image (ShowImageLoadingIndicator, ShowImageErrorIndicator, ImageIndicatorColor). Error statuses (404, 403…) and responses that aren't pictures fail at once instead of being retried, and are no longer written to the disk cache; cached bytes that don't decode are dropped. Custom elements can use SkiaRowContainer.MarkImageLoading / DrawImageError.

2.0.0-rc.2.3: a list aligned Start/Center/End on its scroll axis (VerticalOptions for a vertical list, HorizontalOptions for a horizontal one) is as long as its items, so its parent can center it; longer lists still scroll.

2.0.0-rc.2.2: templates honour Row/Column/RowSpan/ColumnSpan written on a Grid element without the "Grid." prefix (as MAUI does).

2.0.0-rc.2.1: Labels wrap as in MAUI (WordWrap by default, CharacterWrap, MaxLines, head/middle/tail truncation). Templates: {x:Static} resolves through prefixes, XmlnsDefinition URLs and the global xmlns; markup extensions of other libraries (e.g. icon packs) are provided as XAML would; FontImageSource draws in Image/ImageButton; templates in files with the global default xmlns are compiled; Grid row/column definitions written as elements (with bound sizes) are compiled. interactive template elements can own their taps (HandlesTap: a toggle button's tap doesn't also select the row); the XAML generator emits attached properties of library types in item templates (e.g. SkiaToggleGroup.SelectedValue).

2.0.0-rc.2 targets .NET 11 / MAUI 11 RC2 (1.4.x targets .NET 10).
New: SelectionMode, SelectedItem(s), SelectedItemTemplate and SelectionChangedCommand; CheckBox colors and size (SkiaEx attached properties); rows redraw when their item raises PropertyChanged (ObserveItemChanges); loading placeholders with shimmer; ripple feedback; AutoColumns for grids, with automatic rows in horizontal grids (MinimumItemHeight); ItemAspectRatio; FreezeGcWhileScrolling (CoreCLR) and LogJank diagnostics; font fallback for characters a font lacks; lists keep their gestures inside scrolling parents.
Interactive template elements (ISkiaInteractiveElement): an element of a baked row takes gestures and is painted live while touched (SkiaMauiControls' SkiaGalleryView uses it). The XAML generator emits template elements of any type that implements ISkiaRenderable.
Layout: a Start/Center/End Border without a size hugs its content; * rows and columns of a grid in an Auto track keep at least their content size; stack layouts report their size to grids.
